title: A query can define the internal format string measure as a query measure
query: DEFINE MEASURE Sales[_Sales Amount FormatString] = "0" EVALUATE ROW ( "Fs", 'Sales'[_Sales Amount FormatString] )

source.quote: If the format string expression is defined for a measure, it can be rewritten as a query measure in a DAX query.
source.supports: DEFINE MEASURE Sales[_Sales Amount FormatString] replaces it for the query

derivation: The query measure is the one the query's reference reaches: "0".
